brand.name: Consmat AI
brand.description: B2B Construction Materials Procurement Marketplace in India

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure tight letter spacing for headings. DO NOT use generic fonts for headings. Load Chivo and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind config with these exact colors. Use background for main body, panels for cards/modals/dropdowns. Do NOT use standard gray gradients. Accent color #ff7a2f MUST be used for primary CTAs and active states.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat panels (#171c22) with 1px border-white/10. NO transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers. Headers must have a solid background (#0f1216 or #171c22) to prevent text collision. Use a slight blur if using semi-transparent, but prefer solid.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) on panels, radius 12px (rounded-xl) for modern industrial feel.

layouts.grid: High Density Grid for dashboards. Mobile-first grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for vendor cards. Strict hierarchy. Use gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Large gaps between distinct sections.
layouts.container: Max-width 7xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 for main layout.
layouts.header: Sticky header, z-50, solid background (#0f1216). Must include Location Picker and 'Cheapest <-> Best quality' slider.

components_strategy.general: Use Shadcn components but strip default 'Vercel' look to match tactical industrial dark theme.
components_strategy.cards: Vendor Match Cards: must show landed price, logistics breakdown, quality stars, warehouse distance, and 'why' explanation. Dense but highly legible.
components_strategy.ai_chat: Chat Panel: sleek terminal-inspired but modern. Responses with dark orange/gray chips for suggestions. Include ranked vendor cards in chat and 'Add all to cart'.
components_strategy.tables: BOM Estimate Table: flat, no rounded inner cells, clear borders, sticky headers. Use solid #171c22 for table background.
components_strategy.modals: Checkout Modal: Solid #171c22 background, dim #000000/80 backdrop. Clear UPI/Card/Credit options.
components_strategy.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize sizes (w-5 h-5 for inline, w-8 h-8 for featured).
components_strategy.toasts: Use sonner for notifications. Dark theme configured.
components_strategy.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add descriptive data-testid to every interactive element (e.g., login-submit, location-picker, shop-mode-tab, slider-price-quality).

motion.hover: Subtle translation (-translate-y-1 on cards) and border highlight (border-[#ff7a2f]/50).
motion.transitions: Target specific properties. DO NOT use 'transition-all'. Use transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching panel color (#171c22) and subtle pulse.

login_bg.description: Modern construction site crane (Use as faded background for login)

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. AVOID AI slop. Stick to the sharp, dark, high-contrast industrial aesthetic defined.
NO transparent dropdowns or header backgrounds. Always apply #171c22 or #0f1216 to surface backgrounds.
NEVER use generic emoji icons (🤖🧠💡) - rely purely on lucide-react.

Implement the API integrations strictly as described (GET /materials, POST /match, POST /ai/chat, POST /estimate, POST /optimize, POST /orders/checkout, GET /orders). Add token Bearer header using the user's JWT.
Ensure the 'Cheapest <-> Best quality' slider is a prominent 0-100 range input in the header.
Format all prices using INR ₹ symbol.
Always use data-testid on interactive elements for testing.
Make sure the App does NOT have default text-align: center applied. Left-align text.
Create a solid Mobile-first layout: stack columns on mobile, use grid-cols-3 or 4 on desktop.
